errors.evidence: The description states that after the initial point, the Z Score 'promptly decreases'. However, the plot shows that the line first rises from a Z Score of about 0.1 to a small peak of about 0.5 (at x ≈ 0.03 * 10^7) before it begins to decrease.
The description states the minimum point is at approximately 0.15x10^7 tokens. Visually, the minimum occurs further along the x-axis, closer to 0.17x10^7 or 0.18x10^7.

errors.text_span: 整条曲线呈现先降后升再降的“倒U型”趋势
errors.evidence: This summary is both contradictory and inaccurate. It first describes the trend as 'fall-rise-fall' ('先降后升再降'), which is an oversimplification that ignores the initial rise. It then labels this pattern as an 'inverted U-shape' ('倒U型'), which typically describes a rise-then-fall curve, contradicting the first part of the phrase. Neither description accurately represents the full complexity of the curve (rise-fall-rise-fall).
